snippet.title: Razorlocks Teaser Trailer - Wishlist on Steam!
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1395290/Razorlocks/

Blaze the trails, race your heart out, and let your bladed hair down to explore in this upcoming 3D platformer. Razorlocks is on a journey of speeding to the top and realizing her potential with strands of both style and substance.
